title: R2 · centred point
changes: The point is on the dot-to-nub centreline, and the yellow ends at the nub's centre.
Both edges follow one convex width curve from the dot, g(f)=(1-f)(1+1.31f), with no corner.
Ridges are cut only into the gripping face, with a 1 mm lip at each face, and follow the curved jaw edge.
The beak is symmetric on both faces and ends in a rounded nub about 2 mm across.
review: Ridges break out of the edge where the beak thins.
The outer edge is slightly too lean at the 3rd-5th slots.
The beak looks one-sided in edge.png. That turned out to be the 75 deg render camera; it is symmetric edge-on.
Give the plan point about a 0.5 mm radius so it doesn't read as a spear.
Ridges stop short of the point.
Fillet the shoulder step above the black dot.
